_doc: Rim ray surface (Ch16, M4-A2P-056; docs/kb/art/wildlife.md). One slot; write_materials.py writes assets/wildlife/rim_ray/materials/skin.tres on game/world/wildlife/wildlife.gdshader. A wet, slick skin (wetness 0.4 in build_rim_ray.py) under a hand of water. wing_pivot is build_rim_ray.py's body edge (BODY_X, at the disc's mid-height); the flap (mode 1) beats the fins about it, flap_lag carrying the wave out to the tips, flap_bob lifting the body a little on each beat.
